title: Dotson becomes a friend

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I ended our conversation so abruptly and without due respect for your gracious time and pleasant company.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ended our conversation so abruptly and without due respect for your gracious time and pleasant company.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Let us move on as we progress through the formalities of acquaintance and form a bond of friendship which we will cherish through times both prosperous and perilous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let us move on as we progress through the formalities of acquaintance and form a bond of friendship which we will cherish through times both prosperous and perilous.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Very well. Now that we are established as close friends, might I suggest we expand our relationship into a professional one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very well. Now that we are established as close friends, might I suggest we expand our relationship into a professional one?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Please wait till you hear the details of my proposal before you make a final decision

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please wait till you hear the details of my proposal before you make a final decision

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Partnership old friend! I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Partnership old friend! I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Let me be clear, my expectations are exacting. We may already be close friends, best buds, companions beyond compare.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me be clear, my expectations are exacting. We may already be close friends, best buds, companions beyond compare.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Not so hasty my friend. To join my detective agency, you will have to progress through the rigorous entrance exam process. Prepare yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not so hasty my friend. To join my detective agency, you will have to progress through the rigorous entrance exam process. Prepare yourself.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: But of course! Dotson's Detective Agency: Nivalis' finest, cheapest detectives. Formerly two androids working together, now one seeking a partner. A partner like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But of course! Dotson's Detective Agency: Nivalis' finest, cheapest detectives. Formerly two androids working together, now one seeking a partner. A partner like you.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Await my call. I will have your first task ready. It shall be a difficult one, and yet the easiest of the three challenges. Take faith my friend, you are up to this challenge!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Await my call. I will have your first task ready. It shall be a difficult one, and yet the easiest of the three challenges. Take faith my friend, you are up to this challenge!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I shall leave you with a taster of the task ahead. Answer me this - what separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I shall leave you with a taster of the task ahead. Answer me this - what separates an amateur sleuth from a master detective in Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Good day. I must apologize for my previous impropriety. I trust you will not consider it a black mark upon my character.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good day. I must apologize for my previous impropriety. I trust you will not consider it a black mark upon my character.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Do you agree to this course of action which establishes us both as a duo worthy of engaging anecdotes and esteem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you agree to this course of action which establishes us both as a duo worthy of engaging anecdotes and esteem?

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I am willing to pay you handsomely for your services.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am willing to pay you handsomely for your services.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days, but with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe a friendship like ours can endure a thousand stormy days, but with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: But with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But with the sunshine of a lucrative shared vocation, it can also bloom like a glorious garden.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: But I must be fair during the interview process, and I cannot lower my standards!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I must be fair during the interview process, and I cannot lower my standards!

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Even though my heart may cry out for the successful appointment of my friend as my new business partner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even though my heart may cry out for the successful appointment of my friend as my new business partner.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: This did not escape my inquisitive, sharp eyes, but was dismissed as insignificant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This did not escape my inquisitive, sharp eyes, but was dismissed as insignificant.

nodes.speaker: Dotson
nodes.text: Prepare an answer, for your first challenge will test your insight, wit, guile and mental aptitude. Good day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Prepare an answer, for your first challenge will test your insight, wit, guile and mental aptitude. Good day!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just like you as a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just like you as a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I just like you as a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I just like you as a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm no android though. Just in case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm no android though. Just in case.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm no android though. Just in case.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm no android though. Just in case.

Friend/Business icon meanings come from gameplay; Enemy's UI label is unconfirmed.
Routes stop at this conversation's exit; external dialogue gates are shown separately.
